messages:
jordan (sec): FYI CVE-2026-21445 flagged in OpenSSL/libssl. Affects alpine:3.18-slim and ubuntu-minimal base images we publish. Need triage + quick remediation plan.
neha (eng-infra): Can you paste the CVSS and any exploitability notes? which images exactly (tags + registries)? :eyes: 
jordan (sec): CVSS 7.8 (remote exploit with crafted TLS handshake). PoC not public but vendor released patches for openssl 3.1.2 and ubuntu/glibc compat updates. Affected images: `redwood/base:alpine-3.18-slim`, `redwood/base:ubuntu-22.04-minimal`, internal-debian-light for some on-prem nodes.
kai (eng-sre): Impact: runtime processes using system OpenSSL (most inference sidecars + metrics exporter). We should avoid breaking ABI. Suggest rebuild with vendor packages, enable KMS-signed image attestation, and a staged canary rollout.
sasha (platform): Agree. Also want to rotate cosign key and lock down push RBAC so only `image-release` role can sign+publish. That means a short RBAC change in registry perms. We need audit logging enabled for publish events.
jordan (sec): Proposed minimal plan:
```
- bump openssl -> vendor patched package (alpine: `openssl 3.1.2-r1`, ubuntu: `openssl 3.1.2-4ubuntu1`)
- rebuild base images with `docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --push` in CI
- sign images with cosign using KMS: `cosign sign --key ksm://projects/…/locations/global/keyRings/…/cryptoKeys/…`
- create SLSA attestation artifact and attach via cosign `cosign attest`
- push to staging registry, run smoke tests, promote to canary (5% traffic) -> 2h monitoring -> full rollout
```
neha (eng-infra): On the KMS side, we need to confirm GCP KMS IAM: allow `ci-service-account` to `cryptoKeySign` and only `image-release` principal to `cryptoKeyVersionDestroy`. Also add key rotation policy (30d) after the rollout. I'll open the IAM PR.
kai (eng-sre): For canary health checks: 1) model-serving readiness, 2) gradient-worker TLS handshake tests, 3) exporter scrape. I can add a smoke test job that runs `openssl s_client -connect $POD_IP:443 -tls1_3` and a quick request to `/healthz`. If any TLS error -> rollback.
sasha (platform): RBAC change: registry perms + k8s `image-puller` role unchanged; only `image-publisher` becomes restricted. We should add an audit rule that logs `cosign sign` actions and registry push events to our audit logs. Who owns the audit log policy?
jordan (sec): Security owns audit policy; infra implements. I'll draft the policy snippet: `allow audit:registry.push,signature.create` and forward to retention 365d.
neha (eng-infra): Need to coordinate on bundle attestation storage. Suggest using the same GCS bucket we use for SBOMs with object ACLs locked and bucket encryption via KMS. Also ensure private deployments can fetch attestations (we provision a read-only service account).
kai (eng-sre): Schedule wise: can we do rebuild + staging sign today? Then canary tomorrow morning during low traffic window (04:00 UTC)?
sasha (platform): Works for me. I will queue a release and block `image-release` until IAM PR merges.
deploy-bot: build started for redwood/base:alpine-3.18-slim-patched (build id: bld-8721)
jordan (sec): Action items:
- neha: IAM PR for KMS key perms + bucket ACL (due EOD)
- sasha: registry RBAC change and release block (due EOD)
- kai: smoke-test job + canary playbook (due tomorrow 03:00 UTC)
- jordan: publish audit policy and coord with compliance (due EOD)
Please react with :thumbsup: if you accept assignments.
neha (eng-infra): :thumbsup: will open PR and ping here.
sasha (platform): :thumbsup: locking registry perms now.
kai (eng-sre): :thumbsup: will push smoke tests to CI.
jordan (sec): Thanks — I'll monitor the build and post next steps. If any service shows TLS handshake failures we roll back to previous tag and revoke attestations. :white_check_mark:
